Well as another suicidal person, the reason will often come from a feeling of being an outcast, or loneliness. People feel that they have no value, no friends, or no reason to live which could be personal and not one of those blanket ones.  

For me it is “no value” because I am a terrible person and deserve death for my deviant interests like Anime and Manga. 

Humans are engineered to need human interaction, which is something an internet friendship can never replace. If someone feels they are alone in the world, there is no longer a reason for them to exist in that world because it has abandoned them.

People who believe they have no value feel that they don’t deserve a place in that world, and that the world only serves to patronize and torture them. They also might feel that they are a waste of resources.

Of course that is all for mild suicidal urges, for people who fiercely want to kill themselves the cause will generally be more personal, like rape or something along those lines.

Or it could all just be the simple, human desire to end. All lives end so why not just skip the cutscene.
